nodes.reason: The prose and Lean proposition agree on every hypothesis and all four conclusions. The orthonormal isometry, nonzero integer-coordinate separation, integer-box cardinality and sum-of-squares norm bound establish the claimed finite set. The construction also handles M = 0 and dim V = 0. All six proof steps are complete and independent of the parent and siblings; the ℓ² construction has the intended instance.

The prose and Lean proposition contain exactly the invariance, membership, norm and separation assumptions. Invariance at −x gives equal masses, separation makes the open balls disjoint, and the norm bound gives containment. Measurable finite additivity and monotonicity prove the ENNReal inequality. The proof remains valid for an empty set, arbitrary real ρ and infinite measures; no additional finiteness or positivity assumption is hidden.

The real coefficients and natural exponents and indices match the prose exactly. Assuming r > n, the explicit Archimedean choice gives M ≥ 1 and aM > b. Exponent monotonicity followed by cancellation of the strictly positive M^n contradicts this. Every step is justified using only the stated assumptions, including when b is negative; there is no circular reliance or deferred proof construction.
